opportunities.title: Open Circuit Hackathon 2026
opportunities.clause: Teams of 2 to 4 members, each enrolled full-time in an undergraduate programme at a recognised college in India.
opportunities.reasoning: Any full-time undergraduate team of 2–4 qualifies. No other conditions.
opportunities.fit: Idea submission fits Saturday's 7 free hours.

opportunities.title: Tidewater Labs Summer Internship
opportunities.clause: Open to students in the 2nd or 3rd year of a B.E./B.Tech programme in Computer Science, IT or Electronics.
opportunities.reasoning: Year and branch match the clause exactly.
opportunities.fit: Application already sent; one follow-up fits Wednesday evening.

opportunities.title: Lantern Open Source Microgrant
opportunities.reward: Up to ₹1,50,000 for an open source project
opportunities.clause: Individuals based in India maintaining a public project under an OSI-approved licence. Applications must include one endorsement from a mentor or maintainer.
opportunities.clauseSource: Lantern Fund FAQ, Who can apply
opportunities.reasoning: Eligibility is met. The application can't be submitted until the endorsement arrives.

opportunities.title: Kestrel Foundation Merit Scholarship
opportunities.clause: Applicants must demonstrate a consistently strong academic record throughout their degree.
missing: The clause never defines 'consistently strong' (no CGPA cutoff)
CGPA not in your profile yet
opportunities.reasoning: The rule is subjective. Worth emailing the foundation to ask for the cutoff.

opportunities.title: Saffron Trust Need-Based Scholarship
opportunities.clause: Annual family income from all sources must be below ₹3,00,000, supported by an income certificate issued in the last 12 months.
missing: Family income not in your profile
Income certificate not marked as on hand
opportunities.reasoning: Can't confirm until income details are added to your profile.

opportunities.title: Northstar Institute Research Fellowship
opportunities.clause: Undergraduates in any year may apply. Preference will be given to candidates with prior research experience or a publication.
missing: No research experience listed in your profile
opportunities.reasoning: Anyone can apply, but your chances depend on research experience.

opportunities.title: Meridian First-Year Scholarship
opportunities.clause: Applicants must be enrolled in the first year of a full-time undergraduate degree at the time of application.
opportunities.reasoning: A hard exclusion: the sample profile is past first year.

opportunities.title: Coral Science Talent Award
opportunities.clause: Open only to students pursuing B.Sc. or integrated M.Sc. programmes in the natural sciences. Engineering and professional courses are excluded.
opportunities.reasoning: A B.E./B.Tech programme falls under the excluded category.
